remarks: Discover urban living at its finest in this 10th-floor unit at Fountain Terrace, nestled atop Strawberry Hill with panoramic views of the city and Long Island Sound. Freshly painted, this 2-bedroom, 1-bath home features a spacious living and dining area, and newly updated bathroom vanity, complemented by a south-facing private balcony-perfect for morning coffee or unwinding at the end of the day. Fountain Terrace offers exceptional amenities, including a gated entry with 24-hour security, assigned parking, an outdoor pool, clubhouse, playground, private storage unit, exercise room, and community room. Laundry facilities are conveniently located in the basement. Monthly common charges include heat, hot water, sewer, water, trash removal, snow and grounds maintenance, basic cable, internet, and cooking gas-offering comfort and value in one package. Experience the ease of city living with all the perks of a well-appointed community-just minutes from Metro North train station, I-95, schools, shopping, and the vibrant dining and entertainment of Downtown Stamford and Harbor Point!
